statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let W := fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Q n)^2 ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ p q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ ((Q n:ℝ)^2)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (high n) t‖^2; let T := fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))^4; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∀ j : ℕ, let y := (2:ℝ)^j*T n; y * m ((B n \ (W n (fun _ => True))) ∩ {t : ℝ | y < F n t ∧ F n t ≤ 2*y}) (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/(100000*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))^2)

plain_statement.en: Dyadic level-set conjecture for large values on deep minor arcs

brief.zh: 这是较强的单层面积猜想。可从大筛的采样点间距入手，也可寻找违反界的层。限制到有效层后可推出深次弧大峰值总预算。
brief.en: This stronger conjecture bounds each height bin. Try large-sieve spacing or identify a violating bin. Restriction to surviving heights suffices for the integrated spike budget.
